name: bog_wail_launch
for: hollowmere_screamer bog wail: release at the mouth
notes: One-shot at the open jaw: a gout of black bog water bursts forward and breaks up, spattering drops and weed bits that fall, while two sickly-green wail crescents punch out and fade. Faces +x; anchor = the mouth (pivot). Mouth sits ~2.5 m up on the throw frame.
